* Design the subscriber data migration strategy — at the functional level: defining which subscriber segments migrate, the business rules governing data transformation, suppression list governance, consent record mapping requirements and the subscriber validation criteria the business will use to sign off each data wave.
* Own the consent and compliance architecture — mapping legacy consent records, preference data and suppression lists to Marketing Cloud Next consent model and Data Cloud consent API, ensuring GDPR, CAN\-SPAM, CASL and POPI obligations are met in the migrated platform from day one.
* Design the journey migration blueprint — inventorying and assessing all legacy journeys, drip campaigns and triggered sends; prioritising for migration, rebuild or retirement; mapping legacy automation logic to Journey Builder native capabilities; and defining the functional acceptance criteria for each migrated journey.
* Lead Data Cloud integration design — defining the unified customer profile architecture, data stream sources, identity resolution business rules, audience segmentation strategy and activation targets for Marketing Cloud Next — in collaboration with the Data Cloud Architect.
* Manage scope and functional sign\-off — maintaining the solution scope register, managing scope change requests, producing functional design documents and obtaining formal business sign\-off at each MDLC phase gate before the Technical Architect begins build.
* Serve as Trusted Advisor to the client — building long\-term relationships with client marketing technology leads, digital directors, CDOs and Enterprise Architects; providing candid guidance on MCN platform capabilities, migration trade\-offs and post\-migration marketing strategy.
* Govern functional quality of deliverables — reviewing all functional design documents, process maps, data mapping sheets, journey design artefacts and user acceptance test scripts produced by the track team to ensure they meet factory quality standards and client expectations.
* Validate business process equivalence post\-migration — leading user acceptance testing (UAT) planning, supporting client business users through UAT execution, managing defect triage and confirming that migrated journeys, subscriber segments and send logic deliver the same business outcomes as the legacy platform.
* Lead email deliverability strategy — advising on IP warm\-up planning, domain authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), sender reputation management and inbox placement testing strategy post\-migration.
* Contribute to the Migration Factory — building reusable MCN solution design templates, discovery workshop guides, journey migration assessment frameworks, consent architecture blueprints and migration approach documents for the factory accelerator library.
* Support pre\-sales and solutioning — contributing to proposal development, migration scope estimation, resource planning and solution presentations for prospective Marketing Cloud Next migration engagements.

Able to architect solutions end\-to\-end and lead discovery without referring to technical resources for platform capability questions.
* Salesforce Data Cloud: Solid understanding of Data Cloud architecture — data streams, unified profiles, identity resolution, segmentation and activation to MCN — sufficient to own the functional integration design and validate the Data Cloud Architect's technical approach.
* Subscriber Data Model \& Consent Architecture: Deep understanding of MCN subscriber data model — data extensions, sendable/non\-sendable objects, contact counts, suppression lists — and proven expertise designing consent migration strategies that comply with GDPR, CAN\-SPAM, CASL and POPI.
* Legacy Marketing Platform Knowledge: Working knowledge of at least one major legacy marketing platform (Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, legacy SFMC Classic) — sufficient to run discovery workshops, assess migration complexity and translate legacy features to MCN equivalents.
* Journey \& Campaign Migration Strategy: Proven ability to inventory, assess and prioritise complex legacy marketing automation libraries — mapping legacy journey logic, drip campaigns and triggered send rules to Journey Builder native design patterns.
* Email Deliverability: Solid understanding of email deliverability principles — IP warm\-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, sender reputation, inbox placement — to advise clients on post\-migration deliverability strategy.
* Integration Architecture Awareness: Understanding of Marketing Cloud Connect (CRM sync), REST/SOAP MC APIs, API\-triggered sends and event\-driven messaging — sufficient to design functional integration specifications and validate the TA's implementation approach.
* Data Migration Strategy (Functional): Ability to define what data migrates, the business transformation rules governing subscriber and consent data, validation criteria for data sign\-off and the business cutover sequence — partnering with the TA and Data Cloud Architect for ETL execution.

 Senior Technical Lead – Product Releases \& Engineering
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

 We are looking for a mature, hands\-on Senior Technical Lead who can bring structure, predictability and ownership to the engineering and release process for Stratpilot.
   

  

 The role sits between the Product Owner, Delivery Manager, Technical Architect and engineering team. Your primary responsibility is to ensure that multiple developers, features and code changes come together into stable, well\-coordinated product releases.
   

  

 This is not simply a senior developer role and it is not a purely managerial position. You must remain technically hands\-on while taking ownership of release coordination, engineering discipline and day\-to\-day technical delivery.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Release Management
   

  

 You will coordinate releases across Development → Test / QA → UAT → Production → Monitoring.
   

  

  

* Coordinate release scope with the Product Owner and Delivery Manager, maintaining visibility of features, fixes and dependencies
* Ensure development, code reviews, integration and testing are completed before release and conduct technical release\-readiness checks
* Coordinate application, API, database and configuration changes; manage release branches, versioning, hotfixes and production fixes
* Coordinate deployments across Dev, Test, UAT and Production, support UAT issue resolution and provide technical Go / No\-Go recommendations
* Ensure rollback or recovery procedures are understood, validate Production releases and coordinate post\-release issue resolution


 The objective is to create a repeatable, controlled and increasingly automated release process rather than relying on individual developers or last\-minute effort.
   

  

 Engineering Team Coordination
   

  

  

* Maintain visibility of development progress and identify dependencies across frontend, backend, database and integrations
* Ensure developers understand requirements and technical expectations; identify blockers and risks early
* Coordinate work where features cross multiple components, help resolve difficult technical issues and review progress against sprint and release commitments
* Escalate architectural concerns to the Technical Architect, delivery risks to the Delivery Manager, and work with the Product Owner where requirements need clarification


 The successful candidate should bring structure without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
   

  

 Engineering Maturity \& Quality

* Environment management, logging and monitoring, technical documentation, incident management and root\-cause analysis
* Technical\-debt management and secure development practices


 You will ensure code produced by different developers is properly reviewed, consolidated and integrated before entering shared environments.
   

  

 Hands\-On Technical Capability

You should have hands\-on experience using Google Cloud services to deploy, operate, monitor and troubleshoot production SaaS applications, and be confident managing GitHub repositories, pull requests, branching strategies, code reviews, permissions and GitHub Actions\-based CI/CD workflows.

 Experience with AI applications, LLMs, agents, RAG, MCP, LangGraph/LangChain, OpenAI, Claude or Gemini would be advantageous.
   

  

 Production \& Incident Management
   

  

  

* Assess incident severity and impact, coordinate developers during investigation and identify root causes
* Manage hotfixes and emergency releases, communicate technical status clearly and validate systems following fixes
* Conduct root\-cause reviews and ensure preventative actions are completed

* Coordinating development teams and managing SaaS releases into Production across Dev, Test, UAT and Production environments

* Release\-readiness, deployment processes, code consolidation and strong code\-review practices

**Overview**
 Would you like to help shape the UI platform that powers Windows experiences used by millions of developers and customers every day? The Windows Platform \& Developer (WPD) Organization team builds and evolves the UI frameworks and APIs that first and thirdparty developers rely on to create highquality desktop and enterprise line\-of\-business (LOB) applications.

* AI‑first developer experience: Design WinUI to be natively consumable by AI agents, with clear semantic models, stable abstractions, and predictable composition patterns that allow agents to author, refactor, and optimize UI code at scale.
* Seamless migration and adoption: Use AI‑assisted tooling and compatibility layers to enable low‑friction migration from legacy Windows UI stacks and SwiftUI on macOS, making WinUI a competitive and approachable choice for modern app developers.
* Declarative, dynamic UI foundation: Evolve WinUI into a truly declarative, state‑driven framework that supports real‑time personalization, adaptive layouts, and agent‑driven UI mutation without sacrificing performance or reliability.
* Lowering the barrier for web and SwiftUI developers: Provide opinionated projections, simplified APIs, and familiar programming models that align with modern web and SwiftUI mental models, accelerating time‑to‑productivity on Windows.
* Future‑proofing for AI‑generated code: Architect WinUI so that a majority of UI code can be safely generated and maintained by AI agents—emphasizing composability, guardrails, testability, and runtime validation.
